question: Which no-code owner, path, and contract package governs public extraction and later consumer/private integration seams?

considered_options.benefit: Closes all six no-code owner seams while retaining every later mutation and promotion pause gate.
considered_options.cost_or_risk: Makes the named owner and protocol contracts controlling until replaced by another explicit decision.
considered_options.when_to_choose: Choose when the stream should continue through the smallest public-safe candidate slice.
considered_options.downstream_impact: IRO-001 may pass and project IRO-002; IRO-002 still pauses for separate candidate-mutation approval.

considered_options.benefit: Preserves all current authority boundaries without making owner assignments.
considered_options.cost_or_risk: Leaves IRO-001 blocked and prevents candidate work.
considered_options.when_to_choose: Choose when any named owner, locator, field, or contract needs renegotiation.
considered_options.downstream_impact: No successor is selected or executed.

considered_options.benefit: Ends the one-shot stream without further work.
considered_options.cost_or_risk: The intended add-on remains unimplemented and unverified.
considered_options.when_to_choose: Choose when the objective should be abandoned.

rationale: The operator explicitly selected the recommended smallest-reliable, owner-scoped, propose-then-promote package. It binds no-code contracts now and preserves separate approvals for every later mutation boundary.

bindings.subject: public_extraction
bindings.owner: Vladimir Vrondelli as private-source owner and public-Arcanum maintainer
bindings.contract: Author a fresh behavior-only public-safe extraction. The private comparison path is read-only evidence; do not copy private prose, code, package metadata, or types. Candidate writes begin only after the IRO-002 approval; canonical writes begin only after the IRO-004 public-owner and clean-worktree gate.

bindings.subject: canonical_api_name_license_compatibility
bindings.contract: Canonical id and directory are intent-route-resolver. Protocols are intent-route.request@1, intent-route.disposition@1, and intent-route.runtime-port@1; catalog and closure identities use lowercase SHA-256. Apply the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 and Required Notice from arcanum/LICENSE. Unsupported versions and digest mismatches fail closed; any protocol major requires new Define/Design, fixtures, and explicit consumer migration.

bindings.subject: catalog_projector
bindings.owner: Vladimir Vrondelli for the disposable witness; each named capability owner plus confirmed Dispatch owner for later consumers
bindings.path: first-witness=/home/vrondelli/projects/intent-route-resolver-disposable-consumer/adapters/catalog-projector.mjs; every later consumer path must come from its explicit owner receipt
bindings.contract: Project only exact capability and confirmed Dispatch IDs, revisions, and content digests or reject. The projector is read-only and may not discover, create, repair, rank, register, persist, approve, dispatch, bind, or execute. This binding does not approve creation of the disposable repository or any later consumer adapter.

bindings.subject: request_normalization
bindings.owner: Vladimir Vrondelli for the disposable witness; each consumer runtime owner for its adapter
bindings.path: first-witness=/home/vrondelli/projects/intent-route-resolver-disposable-consumer/adapters/request-normalizer.mjs; every later runtime path must come from its explicit owner receipt
bindings.contract: Construct intent-route.request@1 only from runtime-owned captured input or reject with a typed error. Do not infer missing semantics, negotiate protocol behavior, discover capabilities, or apply compatibility fallback. This binding does not approve creation of the disposable repository or any later runtime adapter.

bindings.subject: aci_reference_fields
bindings.owner: Vladimir Vrondelli as private CAV2/ACI authority
bindings.path: contract-anchor=cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/design/aci-reasoning-binding/ARCHITECTURE.md#minimum-cross-boundary-envelope; implementation path must come from the explicit IRO-009 owner receipt
bindings.contract: The private compatibility payload may reference intent_route_request_ref.artifact_ref, intent_route_request_ref.content_digest, intent_route_disposition_ref.artifact_ref, and intent_route_disposition_ref.content_digest. References are content-addressed bytes only; they grant no ACI acceptance, journal write, fallback, dispatch, workflow binding, effect, or promotion authority. IRO-009 still requires exact private scope and field-binding approval.

bindings.subject: disposable_consumer
bindings.owner: Vladimir Vrondelli as add-on lifecycle owner
bindings.contract: Use one isolated Git repository as the first consumer witness. Create or mutate it only after the IRO-006 locator and mutation approval. Prove install presence and execution, disable, uninstall or induced-failure rollback, exact clean-state restoration, and zero product or authority effects before any ResonantOS or orchestrator adoption.

deferred_decisions: Candidate material mutation remains gated before IRO-002.
Canonical public mutation and acceptance remain gated before IRO-004.
Disposable repository creation remains gated before IRO-006.
Exact ResonantOS planning worktree remains gated before IRO-007.
Exact orchestrator adapter scope remains gated before IRO-008.
Exact private CAV2/ACI implementation scope remains gated before IRO-009.
